findings.note: Detroit's defensive line is further depleted: Gill-Howard is out for the season after Hutchinson's ACL tear, and EDGE Wonnum (back) is a game-time call. This page listed Detroit at +2.5, so the +1 being offered may be a worse number.

The Bears ruled out slot CB Kyler Gordon (shoulder) for a second straight game and RB Roschon Johnson (ankle). The page also says Detroit is on a six-game win streak and undefeated at home, while Chicago has not trailed since Caleb Williams returned.

Team-site preview: Detroit has allowed 14.4 points per game over its last five despite losing LB Jack Campbell and DE Aidan Hutchinson. Detroit's offense ranks fifth in scoring, and Chicago has not trailed in five straight games.
